about: The singing test's scoring, version 1, as the server (App\Support\SingingTest\Scoring) and the app's engine compute it; both test against every case here. docs/decisions.md, 2026-11-24.

match.error: the mean |centsOff| over the heard match notes

back.error: the mean |centsOff| over every heard note of every pattern

hold.error: the mean over the heard holds of spreadCents + |driftCents| / 2

rules.points: weight x clamp((floor - error) / (floor - ceiling), 0, 1), kept unrounded; null when nothing in the event is heard
rules.total: round half up of the three events' unrounded points; null for practice
rules.shown: each event's points rounded half up to 1 decimal, never summed
rules.band: from p, the mean |centsOff| over every heard match note and back note: finding p >= 100, closer 60 <= p < 100, nearly 35 <= p < 60, inTune 15 <= p < 35, precise p < 15; null for practice
rules.practice: fewer than 8 match notes heard, fewer than 4 patterns with 3 or more notes heard, or no hold heard
rules.status: practice, else warmup when warmUp, else counted

cases.name: band edge: exactly 15 cents is inTune
band edge: exactly 35 cents is nearly
band edge: exactly 60 cents is closer
band edge: exactly 100 cents is finding
floors: 200 cents and an unsteady hold score nothing
an octave answer, folded, isn't penalised
a warm-up is scored, but marked
seven match notes heard: practice, no total or band
three patterns with 3+ notes heard: practice, their notes still score
nothing heard: practice, every event null
one hold heard of two counts
a total of exactly 71.5 rounds up to 72
